entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Joker!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What a relief. You're safe!
More or less.
Same goes for you.
Come with me.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm not sure what happened, but we[n]seem to be alive...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Huh? I, um...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: By the way, why have you remained in[n]your phantom thief attire while I am[n]back in regular clothes?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Could this mean that the will of rebellion[n]is no longer within me?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...That may be true.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We have to fight that Holy Grail again,[n]correct?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Could you imagine defeating it, Joker?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That monster has the support of the[n]masses, and with it, nearly an infinite[n]amount of power...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I... No matter which way I approach the[n]subject in my head, nothing points to[n]our victory.
I'm not confident either.
I don't know...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I think I finally, genuinely understand[n]the pain my father and my sister were[n]burdened with...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Victory against a single criminal is[n]meaningless... The true enemy is[n]society itself.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: And even against that foe, you still have to[n]try to somehow emerge victorious.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I don't know what to do...
Believe in yourself.
I'll be here for you.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Believe... in myself...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hm...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: *chuckle* You got me.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: [fName]...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You just had to say that like it was the[n]simplest thing in the world...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But... thanks. You're right.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I keep forgetting that it's okay to rely on[n]you at times.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Joker...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...You're right.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's a bad habit of mine. The more critical[n]the situation, the less I want to rely on[n]others...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Regardless, this isn't a situation with a[n]straightforward answer...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But even if there is no clear solution,[n]I'll just have to make one... with my[n]own two hands.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Before you guys came along, my life was[n]defined by rules, set on a path of someone[n]else's choosing...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But only a true loser would live such a[n]rigid life!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I... I will win...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Even if it means going up against the[n]entire world!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm okay. My resolve was shaken, but[n]it's stronger now.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I want the people of the world to see[n]what you've shown me!
Let's go.
Break time's over.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Right!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Thank you. Having teammates you can[n]trust is a great feeling.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Shall we go? We can't let our last big job[n]end in failure!
